import subprocess,json
base='46c71db48f47c5ffb933205a78bf73b372d4ace2'
refs={'main':'main','earshot':'codex/earshot-sound-effects','deepseek':'codex/deepseek-video-agent'}
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True)
sets={k:set(git('diff','--name-only',base,v).splitlines()) for k,v in refs.items()}
for a,b in [('main','earshot'),('main','deepseek'),('earshot','deepseek')]:
 p=sorted(x for x in sets[a]&sets[b] if not x.startswith('.dip/'))
 print(a+' / '+b+': '+json.dumps(p))
print('branch changed file counts: '+json.dumps({k:sum(not p.startswith('.dip/') for p in v) for k,v in sets.items()}))
print('main commit count '+git('rev-list','--count',base+'..main').strip())
print(git('log','--format=%h %s',base+'..main'))
print('main Rust diff stats:')
print(git('diff','--stat','--','classic/rust/crates/podcast/src/hard_limiter.rs','classic/rust/crates/timeline/src/batch_edit.rs','classic/rust/crates/timeline/src/caption_text.rs','classic/rust/crates/timeline/src/full_auto_edit.rs','classic/rust/crates/timeline/src/timeline.rs'))
